summary: WAYLOAM v0.3.2.alpha makes route building much faster, stabilizes in-app downloads and introduces expressive wavy progress throughout the app.
highlights: Long bicycle trips now route through Valhalla first instead of waiting on BRouter's restrictive public long-route queue.
The usable route appears before elevation and nearby-service enrichment finishes in the background.
Update downloads keep their current state instead of repeatedly flipping back to Checking.
Planner, updater and Gear progress now use WAYLOAM's Material 3 Expressive-style wavy indicator.
added: Valhalla bicycle routing as the fast primary online route engine, with BRouter retained as fallback.
Parallel Photon place lookup for origin and destination, with polite sequential Nominatim fallback.
Background route enrichment for elevation and route-corridor POIs.
API-36-compatible expressive wavy progress indicator with determinate and indeterminate states.
changed: Build route now completes as soon as route geometry is ready instead of waiting for Overpass POIs and elevation enrichment.
BRouter fallback timeouts are capped so a failed public service no longer blocks the planner for over a minute.
The route attribution label reflects whether Valhalla or BRouter generated the current route.
Route details show a separate background-enrichment wave after the map is already usable.
fixed: Fixed Settings repeatedly checking for updates and refreshing while DownloadManager is actively downloading an APK.
Fixed long route builds commonly ending in Routing is temporarily busy after a long wait.
Fixed update progress losing visual continuity during lifecycle resume events.
Kept custom stage-boundary edits intact when background elevation and POI enrichment finishes.
